## Historical audit: H0030

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_formal_04/codex_formal_04_I_r1/infer_logs/anko-default-function-arguments/turn_1/trajs.json`. Event references below are to this file’s `main_agent` unless otherwise stated.

| Aspect | Evidence and assessment |
|---|---|
| Goal | The inferred goal was to support default function arguments in Anko. The original task wording is not visible. A baseline call using `a = 2` produced an unexpected `=` syntax error (event 8). |
| Exploration | The student inspected branches, parser grammar, AST, scanner, VM invocation and arity handling (events 4, 12, 14, 18, 24). Creating a branch from `main` failed; it then created one from `master` at the same starting commit (events 4, 6, 8). |
| Changes | The student created a scanner-based source rewriter that lowers defaulted parameters into a variadic function and binding prologue, and invoked it from `Parse` (events 25–28). Subsequent edits changed expression extraction, variadic slicing, default binding and excess-argument checking (events 37–50). Commit `f873a08` recorded two files and 212 insertions (event 56). No new tests were committed in that file list. |
| Validation | The first post-change reproduction still produced a newline syntax error despite relevant package tests passing (event 32). After edits, omitted and supplied values printed `2` and `8`; scope, variadic and invalid-declaration probes produced visible results (events 44–46). Nested defaults, spread arguments and a side-effect probe also produced expected-looking outputs (events 53–54). The final `go build ./... && go test ./...` completed successfully; the parser package had no test files (events 51–52). |
| Outcome | **Formal success reported:** inventory metadata says solved, with 2/2 fail-to-pass and 119/119 pass-to-pass checks. The underlying evaluation output is not reproduced here. The trace independently shows a nonempty committed patch and successful local checks, not exhaustive correctness. Completion metadata reports `end_turn`, not a technical interruption (top-level metadata, characters [0,2169)). |
| Teacher input | Metadata records one teacher check, but the supplied observations contain neither captured system-prompt text nor a delivered online teacher event. Linked hints and after-round reviews establish availability, not receipt. Thus actual teacher input and adoption are **unknown**; the visible investigation and edits cannot be attributed to a teacher (top-level metadata, characters [0,2169); supplied inventory scope note). |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, a passing existing suite did not establish that the new syntax worked: a direct reproduction exposed a failure, followed by revision and targeted probes. Task-specific risks remain hypotheses rather than demonstrated failures: source rewriting may affect diagnostics or unusual nested, multiline, comment, scanner-offset and name-scope cases. The visible tests do not establish behavior across all such cases or confirm every intended semantic requirement. This is a code task, not a Scene trace; visual or geometric checks are inapplicable.
